title: Understanding the Prediction Vector
text: The prediction vector \( \hat{Y} \) is the result of applying the linear regression model to the dataset. It represents the predicted delay times for each flight record.

title: Dimensions of the Design Matrix
text: The design matrix \( X \) includes an intercept and has dimensions corresponding to the number of records and features. In this case, it has $$400$$ rows (one for each flight record) and $$10$$ columns (9 features plus the intercept).

title: Dimensions of the Coefficient Vector
text: The coefficient vector \( \hat{\theta} \) has dimensions that match the number of columns in the design matrix \( X \). Since \( X \) has $$10$$ columns, \( \hat{\theta} \) is a $$10$$ by $$1$$ vector.

title: Calculating the Shape of \( \hat{Y} \)
text: To find the shape of the prediction vector \( \hat{Y} \), consider the multiplication of the design matrix \( X \) with the coefficient vector \( \hat{\theta} \).
